candidates.quote: Eighteen of the ninety apartments would be reserved for lower-income renters.
Households earning no more than sixty percent of area median income would qualify.
Rent plus utilities would be capped at thirty percent of the qualifying income.
The restrictions would run through December 31, 2055.
Quarry Row Homes LP has asked the City to freeze the taxable value of the former quarry parcel for ten years.
Staff recommends that the Council grant the assessment freeze only if the set-aside is written into a recorded agreement.
candidates.value: Grant assessment freeze conditioned on recorded agreement
